body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Philips introduced 'Fidelio Docking speaker' at The Digital Experience, America's largest and best attended consumer electronics media event, which was held annually on the eve of the International Consumer Electronics Show.
